reader_summary.overview: Ben Hunt is the creator of Epsilon Theory and co-founder of Second Foundation Partners, where he writes and invests through the lens of narratives. He has been studying trends using what we now call big data ever since his first book about predicting international conflict in 1997.

key_points.text: Ben Hunt is the creator of Epsilon Theory and co-founder of Second Foundation Partners, where he writes and invests through the lens of narratives.
Our conversation covers Ben 's path to finance, the power of stories, tracking and measuring narratives in markets.
Ben 's insights offer a careful consideration of what's really going on in markets.
